name: io.github.DeviceIngineering/wb-mcp-server
description: Wildberries Seller API: 202 tools — products, prices, orders, ads, supplies, finance.

environmentVariables.name: WB_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Wildberries Seller API token from seller.wildberries.ru (Settings - Access tokens)

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for shops.json, stats.db and the encryption key. Defaults to /data; set it to a writable path for a local install, e.g. ~/.wb-mcp
